title: Security Awareness, Education, and Training
objective: Study-guide review — CISSP — Domain 1: Security and Risk Management: Security Awareness, Education, and Training.

items: Awareness — General understanding of security risks (all employees)
Training — Skills development for specific security tasks (IT/security staff)
Programs must be periodic and reviewed for content relevancy
Social engineering awareness is a critical component

blocks.text: From the Official CBK: "Appropriate levels of awareness, training, and education are required within the organization. Periodic reviews for content relevancy are essential." Security awareness programs should cover:

blocks.title: Exam trap
blocks.text: ⚠️ Exam Trap: Awareness is for EVERYONE. Training is for people with specific security roles. Education is for career development. The exam distinguishes between these three levels.
